title: REST API Decorators
instructions: Complete `config/decorator.py`. Make `BaseApiDecorator` an `Api` that stores the wrapped API in `api` and delegates `execute_request`. Then implement `LoggingDecorator` (calls `ApiUtils.log_request(data)` first) and `RateLimitDecorator` (calls `ApiUtils.apply_rate_limit(data)` first), both via `super().__init__(api)` and returning the wrapped result unchanged.

evidence.label: BaseApiDecorator is an Api that stores `api` and delegates
LoggingDecorator logs the request, then delegates
RateLimitDecorator applies the limit, then delegates
Subclasses keep the wrapped API through the parent constructor
A decorated API is still an Api
Errors from the wrapped API are not swallowed
Works with the real helpers and ECommerceApi
